summary: Four fresh makers, given Zürich's dog register and nothing else, made one form four times: every dog a square in its coat colour, by birth year, the 2,729 dogs with no colour left hollow. Twenty-four column swaps under the drawn parent: 6 unchanged, 18 changed, none broken. A fresh judge without the register refused all 18 changed pages and passed all 10 true ones; a second judge, with the register beside it, read it and returned the same 28 verdicts. The judge without the register checked each page against its own subtitle and against the other pages. Click any mutant to load its swaps into the wiring above.
W1_meaning: A picture works if it actually shows what it says it shows: each of the 10,106 dogs as one field in its registered coat colour, grouped by the dog's year of birth and ordered dark to light within each year, with the undetermined count matching the drawing.
